comment: Everything you can ride: land vehicles, boats, mounts and gliders. Read by src/content/vehicles.ts (and the server, later). Local frame: the vehicle faces +Z, +Y is up, and its right-hand side is -X (the same way the hero faces +Z). Distances in metres, speeds in m/s, rates per second. seats/cargo/wheels are anchor points the 3D models are built around, so moving one here moves it in both the rules and the art.
